title: Outcome-independent grouped development split policy
trigger: PR0005 froze grouped development but not a k-fold count. H4 eligibility established 104 eligible Group-2 events across 69 unordered dyads before any response-class frequencies or model performance were inspected.

primary_validation.fold_count_rule: one held-out unordered dyad per fold; no outcome-dependent fold merging or k selection
primary_validation.models: B0, B1 and B2 use exactly the same folds and fold-local preprocessing
primary_validation.primary_comparison: B2 minus B1 on identical out-of-fold events; lower is better
primary_validation.fold_macro_log_loss: report as descriptive secondary only; cannot change disposition
primary_validation.roc_auc: secondary only when defined; undefined fold AUC cannot alter folds

robustness_validation.role: robustness only; cannot rescue failure of the primary dyad analysis
robustness_validation.models: B1 and B2 on identical leave-initiator-out folds with fold-local preprocessing

required_checks: Every eligible event appears in exactly one primary test fold
Every primary training fold contains both registered response classes affil and avoid
Every robustness training fold contains both registered response classes affil and avoid
No Group-1 nonpartition field is decoded
No fold is dropped, merged or rebalanced based on outcomes
support_gate.allowed_output: aggregate structural booleans and fold-size ranges only; no response-class counts/frequencies, identities or row assignments

fallback: If support fails, RUN-005 is HELD_SPLIT. Do not switch to row-wise CV, choose k after inspecting outcomes, merge rare groups, or alter eligibility/model features.
scientific_boundary: This amendment defines validation mechanics only. It is not biological evidence and does not authorize PR0005 execution until final RDC-004 admission.
